source_hash_scope: cmd/internal/third_party regular files excluding *_test.go and testdata, plus go.mod/go.sum; SHA256(path+NUL+bytes+NUL) in lexicographic path order followed by go.mod/go.sum
scope: isolated actual TLS HTTP/1.1 on loopback, synthetic durable posts; no production deployment, WAN or NIC capacity proof

environment.other_services: live services remained running; no tests/builds concurrent with performance trials
environment.network_classification_updates: enabled, real external public feeds; fetch timing and shared storage variation are not fully controlled

constraints.capacity: one board, 16 threads, 40 bounded actors (80 only in explicitly labeled sensitivity trials), 80% legacy/20% Web, real TLS HTTP/1.1, 2 CPUs and 512MiB (1GiB only in explicitly labeled memory sensitivity trials); two POSTs per logical post
constraints.recovery: 420 scheduled posts at 20/s plus 200 posts during peak, 661 exact DAT lines; drain <=21s, capacity ends <=16s, recovery scheduled p95 <=5000ms
constraints.io_contention: 4..16s only; each writer attempts at most 200 syncs/s, 64KiB per sync and 1MiB file; 1 or 4 writers; actual completed sync count varies and is retained
constraints.durability: proposal Sync -> thread WAL Sync -> decision Sync -> publication; no early ACK
constraints.bounds: posting batch64 / 8MiB; optional queue4096 / 16MiB including inflight; optional batch256 / raw-record JSON4MiB / total frames8MiB; each WAL block64; disk/logical day64MiB and store128MiB remain
constraints.compression: archive encoder, options and smallest-output rule unchanged; byte-boundary batches aligned to64, same256-frame corpus emits exactly the same four encoded blocks; DAT206 identity
constraints.limits: isolated shared SATA SSD; classification feed updater active; auto-pack disabled; not WAN, production SLO, long-retention or unlimited 100/s proof
